source_evidence: Day328~07:40 exact player 'Lets get ready shall we? Whats the plan?' indicates preparation for the offered11:00 Harthvale introduction and asks companions for their plan during breakfast at Copper Hart. Mara recommends presenting genuine river freight and estate interests as a possible regular commercial relationship; letting Harthvale explain his own association, whether and how he directs the broker, what categories of goods he handles and whether he personally authorizes the inspection-information arrangement; asking for nonbinding written terms only if voluntarily offered. Mara offers meaningful social Help when eligible, grounding it in real property interests without exaggerating capacity or making commitments. Cirren recommends establishing Harthvale's own knowledge rather than assuming guilt from leadership, distinguishing commercial offences from violence/coercion and preserving exact firsthand statements; keeping Desen informed of the offered meeting and avoiding further payments or contracts in accordance with Desen's advice. Fenar offers to watch the participants and atmosphere and prioritize safe departure if danger develops; wants to learn how Harthvale treats people who refuse his demands, without assuming wrongdoing. Companions propose a routine message informing Desen of the 11:00 meeting; no actual dispatch, receipt, travel, new spell, feature use, purchase, commitment, or V speech assumed. V controls specific approach and whether to send notice or depart. No uncertain check, no new facts about Harthvale or other actors. Elapsed ten minutes only for strategy discussion, all counters/custody unchanged.
